intent: Report the field capacity in EstateResponse.maxFields from the field schedule constant while leaving hive metadata and pricing behavior unchanged.
rationale: EstateResponse orders field count, maxFields, and next field price before the corresponding hive values. GameStateService currently supplies EstatePrices.MAX_HIVES for maxFields even though EstatePrices defines the field schedule capacity separately as MAX_FIELDS and FarmService enforces that field limit. Replacing only that mismatched constant is the smallest causal repair.
public_checks: Bundle-only static check confirmed EstateResponse.maxFields is paired with EstatePrices.MAX_FIELDS and that MAX_FIELDS is the field schedule capacity.
Confirmed the supplied parent GameStateService.java SHA-256 matches task-manifest parent_source_sha256.
Verified proposal.patch applies cleanly to the exact supplied parent with git apply --check.
uncertainties: Runtime public-test execution remains unconfirmed because the bundled Maven wrapper requires an external Maven distribution that is not included in the bundle.
